  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu_fast_add4 #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] x, y,
    input wire cin,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] s
);
    localparam BLOCKS = (WIDTH + 3) / 4;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(BLOCKS);
    wire [4*BLOCKS-1:0] p, g;
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] gp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] gg [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] bc;

    genvar i, j, k;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 4*BLOCKS; i = i+1) begin: bit_terms
            if (i < WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                assign p[i] = x[i] ^ y[i];
                assign g[i] = x[i] & y[i];
            end else begin: padding
                assign p[i] = 1'b1;
                assign g[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        for (j = 0; j < BLOCKS; j = j+1) begin: block_terms
            assign gp[0][j] = p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & p[4*j+1] & p[4*j];
            assign gg[0][j] = g[4*j+3]
                | (p[4*j+3] & g[4*j+2])
                | (p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & g[4*j+1])
                | (p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & p[4*j+1] & g[4*j]);
        end
        for (k = 0; k < LEVELS; k = k+1) begin: prefix_level
            for (j = 0; j < BLOCKS; j = j+1) begin: prefix_node
                if (j >= (1 << k)) begin: combine
                    assign gp[k+1][j] = gp[k][j] & gp[k][j-(1 << k)];
                    assign gg[k+1][j] = gg[k][j]
                        | (gp[k][j] & gg[k][j-(1 << k)]);
                end else begin: pass
                    assign gp[k+1][j] = gp[k][j];
                    assign gg[k+1][j] = gg[k][j];
                end
            end
        end
        for (j = 0; j < BLOCKS; j = j+1) begin: block_carry
            if (j == 0) begin: first
                assign bc[j] = cin;
            end else begin: later
                assign bc[j] = gg[LEVELS][j-1] | (gp[LEVELS][j-1] & cin);
            end
        end
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i+1) begin: sum_bits
            wire c;
            if ((i % 4) == 0) begin: offset0
                assign c = bc[i/4];
            end else if ((i % 4) == 1) begin: offset1
                assign c = g[i-1] | (p[i-1] & bc[i/4]);
            end else if ((i % 4) == 2) begin: offset2
                assign c = g[i-1] | (p[i-1] & g[i-2])
                    | (p[i-1] & p[i-2] & bc[i/4]);
            end else begin: offset3
                assign c = g[i-1] | (p[i-1] & g[i-2])
                    | (p[i-1] & p[i-2] & g[i-3])
                    | (p[i-1] & p[i-2] & p[i-3] & bc[i/4]);
            end
            assign s[i] = p[i] ^ c;
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_result, sub_ab_result, sub_ba_result;
    pw_alu_fast_add4 #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) add_path (
        .x(a), .y(b), .cin(1'b0), .s(add_result)
    );
    pw_alu_fast_add4 #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) sub_ab_path (
        .x(a), .y(~b), .cin(1'b1), .s(sub_ab_result)
    );
    pw_alu_fast_add4 #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) sub_ba_path (
        .x(b), .y(~a), .cin(1'b1), .s(sub_ba_result)
    );
    always @* begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = add_result;
            3'b001: sum = sub_ab_result;
            3'b010: sum = sub_ba_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = {WIDTH{1'b0}};
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end

    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );

    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index = 0; index < STAGES-1; index = index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index == 0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The targeted path is operand_a/operand_b through arithmetic carry propagation and operation selection into output_pipeline[0].data_reg. The reference leaves all three arithmetic carry structures to generic synthesis.",
  "rewrite": "Replace each arithmetic operator with a parallel four-bit-block carry-lookahead adder. Block generate/propagate terms feed a balanced prefix network; carries within each block are expanded directly. Addition and both subtraction directions remain parallel, so opcode decoding is not inserted ahead of carry propagation. The original operation case and the entire sequential pipeline are retained.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "For WIDTH=16, carry propagation uses four local blocks and two block-prefix levels rather than a potentially long mapped carry chain. This targets improved setup WNS without changing latency. The actual gain is mapping- and placement-dependent; no STA measurement or guaranteed WNS improvement is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Explicit lookahead can increase combinational gate count and wiring compared with compact ripple mapping. No registers are added. Compliance with the 4573.511360um2 cap, mapped equivalence, STA and electrical limits requires evaluation with the specified flow; these results have not been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "All named pipeline registers, their hierarchy, synchronous reset priority, clocking, valid propagation and registered latency are preserved. Arithmetic remains modulo 2^WIDTH; subtraction uses x + ~y + 1 at exactly WIDTH bits. Opcodes 000 through 110 retain their original functions and 111 retains zero output. Data is still computed independently of in_valid. No startup assumptions, initialization, additional state, latches or undefined outputs are introduced. The helper supports positive WIDTH values, including partial four-bit blocks; the pipeline retains the original STAGES structure."
}
